prompts.prompt:
STYLE: 1930s rubber hose cartoon, hand-inked cel animation look, original characters.
Thick uniform outline in dark plum #3D3346 on every shape, clean confident lines, no sketchy strokes.
Flat cel colors with at most one soft shade tone per color, no gradients on characters, no 3D rendering, no glossy plastic look; one small white highlight dot is allowed.
Characters: bendy rubber hose arms and legs with no elbows or knees, white four-finger cartoon gloves, big round shoes, pie-cut eyes (black ovals with a small wedge cut out), simple wide mouth, big head-to-body ratio.
Character colors are saturated: red #D2463C, blue #3E6DB5, yellow #F2C14E, cream #F4E6C8, glove white #FBF6EA.
Backgrounds and large props look like faded watercolor on paper in beige #CFAC8D, sand #D7BE97, dusty navy #4E546E, muted olive #8A9A6B, warm grey #907F77, and are LESS saturated than the characters.
Soft light from the top-left. No cast shadow on the ground. No text, letters or numbers anywhere.
Do not copy any existing cartoon or game character, logo, or scene.

Fill the whole 16:9 canvas edge to edge, no border, no vignette (the game adds its own), no characters, no text.

GRAMO: an old wooden gramophone, grandfather character.
Square cabinet body in reddish-brown wood #8B4A2F with cream #F4E6C8 trim; the cabinet front is his face with pie-cut eyes and a white bushy moustache.
A big brass flower-shaped horn #F2C14E rises from the top like a hat. A wind-up crank handle sticks out of his right side.
Short rubber hose legs with black round shoes, rubber hose arms with white gloves.

PIP: a cheerful young red mailbox #D2463C with a rounded top, standing on one short post that splits into two rubber hose legs with blue #3E6DB5 round shoes.
The mail slot is the mouth, pie-cut eyes above it, a small blue flag on the right side, rubber hose arms with white gloves.

LAMP: a thin dark plum iron street lamp with a curved neck; the glass lantern is the head with two pie-cut eyes. When on, the glass glows warm yellow #F2C14E.

SURVEYOR: a battery-powered surveying robot shaped like a tripod surveying instrument.
A boxy cool grey #9BA3AE metal head with one big round glass lens on the front and two small round glowing dot eyes below it, a short antenna with a tiny orange #E07A3A light.
Three thin perfectly STRAIGHT steel #6E7884 tripod legs (NOT rubber hose, rigid straight lines), one small mechanical claw arm.
Emotionless and precise. Still outlined in dark plum #3D3346 like everything else.

Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished landscape cutscene, exact 16:9 1280x720 canvas, not a collage or sheet. The BACKGROUND RULES 'no characters' clause applies only to unlisted background inhabitants; this STORY cutscene explicitly requires the named characters below. Keep ALL main characters, faces, action props and narrative details in the UPPER 68% of the canvas. Bottom 30% must be quiet low-detail continuous ground/floor for an in-game subtitle overlay; do not draw any subtitle box, panel, lettering or border. No cast ground shadows. References: 1 is primary style and original character anchor; 2 is a reference board (upper left character drawing technique, upper right and lower left watercolor stage technique, lower right village ground palette); never copy its existing game characters, scenes, text or logos. 3 is RADIO cabinet design; 4 is SURVEYOR exact design; 5 is battery pack exact design. Only draw characters explicitly named in the scene. Do not reproduce magenta sheet backgrounds. Background watercolor subtle; character silhouettes clean with plum outlines.

Wide morning village establishing shot. Exactly THREE identical surveyors, each with three rigid tripod legs, one lens and two glowing dots, marching evenly spaced in a single straight line from the road into the village. Bundles of plain survey stakes strapped behind each head. Gramo, Pip and Lamp peek apprehensively from trees and the bandstand. No other characters.

morning, three grey SURVEYOR robots marching into the village in a perfectly straight line from the road, bundles of survey stakes on their backs, GRAMO, PIP and LAMP peeking from behind trees and the bandstand

Wide elevated close view of a single survey stake with a small blank orange tag and antenna. Clearly bounded circular ink-stain-like GREYSCALE region on grass in the upper-middle of the picture; inside the circle every blade, flower and soil is mathematically neutral grey (R=G=B), completely zero saturation. Plants inside are rigid perfectly straight stalks, angular geometric flowers, no curves. Outside, curved organic stems and colored petals in warm village grass. One surveyor recedes at upper-right. This is a loss-of-color zone, NOT a shadow.

a survey stake driven into colorful village grass, a circle of grey color spreading out from it like an ink stain, flowers and grass inside the circle turned colorless and straight, a SURVEYOR walking away in the background

Side-on rightward chase with Bogle on the left and a surveyor ahead on the right heading through a village exit gate. Single cinematic moment of a lonely grey-sepia flashback, ENTIRE IMAGE grey and muted sepia, no saturated colors. Exactly ONE RADIO, being released by a large mechanical hand from a shelf of polished faceless new devices into an open unlabelled scrap box. Radio is visibly still above the rim, sad sagging antenna and downturned grille mouth, hands reaching. This is his BATTERY-POWERED PAST: absolutely NO crank, NO crank wheel, NO side handle, NO brass mechanism on either side. His two tuning dial eyes contain tiny round glowing dot pupils, NOT pie-cut pupils. Use reference 3 for cabinet identity only, remove its crank and cheerful pose.

flashback in grey and sepia tones: inside a big city broadcasting station, RADIO standing on a shelf among many shiny new grey devices, a large mechanical hand dropping him into a scrap box, sad and lonely
